dedupe_keys.name: third generation simulation data tgsim vehicle trajectories fhwa

description: The Third Generation Simulation Data (TGSIM) project, "A Closer Look at the Impacts of Automated Driving Systems on Human Behavior", produced vehicle trajectory datasets published on the US DOT ITS DataHub: I-90/I-94 stationary and moving trajectories, I-294 L1 and L2 trajectories, I-395 trajectories and Foggy Bottom trajectories in Washington, D.C. The I-90/I-94 stationary set, for example, is a 304 MB CSV of position, speed and acceleration for small and large vehicles with level-2 automation and for non-automated vehicles on an urban highway, with aerial reference images and lane centreline files for six collection runs that flag on-ramps, off-ramps and weaving segments. Coverage is a set of US road sites. The data are free to download from the data hub with a recommended citation and DOI (2023); the stationary set was updated in November 2024. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): Public domain (U.S. Government public domain label in the DataCite rights). They support calibration and validation of microscopic traffic models, car-following and lane-changing behaviour with automation, and weaving capacity studies. They follow the earlier NGSIM trajectories and complement the DLR highway and urban trajectory datasets.
